name: Ritika S.
text: Wore it to my cousin's sangeet and got asked 'where did you buy this?' eleven times. I did not buy it. That's the best part.

name: Vikram N.
text: Fit like it was tailored for me. Picked up at 6, returned next morning. Cheaper than a dry-clean of my own suit.

name: Aisha K.
text: Rented it for four hours. Got engaged in it. I'm not saying the dress did it, but I'm not saying it didn't.

name: Pranav M.
text: Crisp, clean and delivered 2 hours before my interview. Got the job. Already listed my own suits here.

name: Divya R.
text: The silk was even richer in person. Lakshmi aunty helped me drape it over video call. Ten stars.

name: Tara J.
text: Booked it for a 4-hour shoot. The photographer literally gasped. Return pickup was right on time.
